_configuration: Tensor split. This is the configuration the fork exists for and the one every published figure refers to. The first calibration run omitted -sm tensor and therefore measured the default layer split, which reads about 0.55x on pp and 0.69x on tg. That run is void.
_cannot_run: Layer split with -fa 0. Tensor split requires flash attention at this pin (llama-context.cpp:3822-3832), so a no-flash-attention arm is not available on this hardware.
_sizes_gb: 0.64, 2.50, 3.31, 5.03, 9.00 -- five points spanning the parameter-size axis, no gap larger than 4 GB
